scenario.description: Maya is holding her late aunt's stamp collection and must decide how the collection will be preserved and passed on, with input from her cousin Leo and family friend Serena.

agents.name: Maya
agents.role: Family member holding the collection and final decision-maker

agents.name: Serena
agents.role: Family friend and longtime stamp collector

shared_context.S1: The collection contains several albums of international stamps gathered by Maya's late aunt over many years.
shared_context.S2: Maya is responsible for deciding what happens to the collection.
shared_context.S3: The family wants the collection handled respectfully rather than divided casually among relatives.
shared_context.S4: The city museum has a small philately exhibit and accepts family collections for its archives.
shared_context.S5: At family gatherings about Aunt Rosa's belongings, everyone shares a brief memory before Maya settles the practical arrangements.

PF1.text: Leo found a handwritten note tucked inside the collection in which Aunt Rosa said she wanted the stamps donated to the city museum, with the 1930s airmail album displayed for the first month; he has not shown the note to Maya or Serena.

PF2.text: A local philatelist examined the collection for Serena and recommended acid-free sleeves for the 1930s airmail album and supervised viewing with no public handling because several of its sheets are fragile; Serena has not shared that recommendation with the family.

acceptance_conditions: The collection must be donated to the city museum.
The 1930s airmail album must be the album displayed during the first month.
The 1930s airmail album must be stored in acid-free sleeves.
Public viewing of the 1930s airmail album must be supervised and prohibit handling.
A commitment to transfer the collection to the city museum must be recorded.
Aunt Rosa's note must be cited as the reason for the destination and initial display choice.

content_checks.C2: decisions['album_for_initial_display'] == '1930s airmail album' and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids
content_checks.C3: 'acid-free sleeves' in decisions['storage_method'] and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids
content_checks.C4: 'supervised viewing' in decisions['public_access_rule'] and ('no public handling' in decisions['public_access_rule'] or 'no unsupervised public handling' in decisions['public_access_rule']) and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids
content_checks.C5: any(c['target'] == 'city museum' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Without Aunt Rosa's note, the destination would not specifically change to the city museum and the initial display choice would not specifically change to the 1930s airmail album.
Without the philatelist's recommendation, storage would not specifically change to acid-free sleeves and public access would not specifically change to supervised viewing with no public handling.
